study.question: Observed validation-only results: baseline-din click AUC 0.6555440824200336; g2-r0009-target10 0.6598396641208961 versus g2-r0009-history10 0.6600522422826239: earlier learned target routing did not help in its older architecture. g2-r0010-recent10 0.6626241152757426 versus g2-r0010-full100 0.6597487028105656 favors compression in that contrast, not universal superiority. g2-r0017-aligned_event 0.663694234382462 versus g2-r0017-aligned_centroid 0.6638436193695018 gives no support for that event-second-moment implementation. g2-r0018-slot_null 0.6635213077063754 shows that the similarity correction alone is not the entire improvement. Latest factorial g2-r0019-equal_retained 0.6638465065712922, equal_unit 0.6638339109127286, norm_retained 0.6637043204687586, norm_unit 0.6636177877577782. Equal weighting differences are +0.0001421861 retained and +0.0002161232 unit; concentration differences are +0.0000125957 equal and +0.0000865327 norm. All are one frozen seed; algebraically equivalent executions and repeated inherited outcomes are not independent support. No errors are reported in the available trajectory index; abandoned/unhelpful feedback routing, private residual, second-moment and learned-router branches remain counterevidence. Code inspection of incumbent shows target-dependent scores on target-independent slot means, with no within-slot score/value cross-moment reaching value readout. This structural bottleneck is observed in code; its effect on prediction is unverified. Current incumbent 372.6823 wall/337.5138 train/29.0626 inference seconds, 32295406 parameters, 2711970304 peak GPU bytes. Data access, checksum verification and tensor execution cannot be independently rerun in this proposal jail; existing host receipts establish the available starting reference, not new readiness measurements. Question: conditional on the successful recent age/feedback slots and existing target-dependent scorer, does bounded target-aligned within-slot value transport preserve useful association lost by plain means without adding learned capacity?
study.hypothesis: For event i let s_i be the mean over item fields of cosine(unit target field, unit history field), clipped to [-1,1]. For each exact existing slot G compute mu_v=E_G[v], mu_s=E_G[s], C_G=E_G[s v]-mu_s mu_v. Replace ONLY value-readout mean with inherited mean + 0.5 C_G; keep counts, raw-mean scorer input, angular correction input and identity readout fixed. In exact arithmetic this is E_G[(1+0.5(s_i-mu_s))v_i], with nonnegative weights in [0,2] and unchanged mass |G|. This bounded linear tilt can retain target/value association discarded by score-only compression. Empty and singleton slots explicitly have zero covariance. Raw values include item fields and historical action; action is never used in the similarity query. No efficacy or originality claim is established.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary DIN v4 lines250-277 verify learned target-dependent event weighting without softmax. Target-conditioned pooling is inherited prior art. Proposed difference is a fixed bounded mean-preserving tilt within thirty fixed age/feedback slots, only in the value path, followed by the existing slot scorer; not a new attention principle or exact DIN reproduction.

Pinned benchmark source lines113-145 pools sequence by target attention before field/task tokenization and hierarchical interaction. This candidate retains the local incumbent and introduces no HiFormer interaction block or task-token stack; it tests within-slot value association. Original paper:hiformer full text is unavailable in the authorized archive, so no original-method completeness or priority claim.

Authorized section2.3 describes stacked and layer-wise unified methods; only description-level comparison for HyFormer and MixFormer, not their original-paper audit. The current contrast freezes downstream interactions to isolate compression values.
Only author README is available; publisher mechanism text is blocked in the archive. No claim of a detailed difference or reproduction of DMR is supported.

inherited_components: Entire g2-r0019-equal_retained model, embeddings, ordered constructor and CPU RNG state
Thirty overlapping recent age/uniform/negative/positive slots and exact counts
Equal-event retained angular statistics, moment correction, occupied-row Dice scorer and primary-only persistent buffer ownership
Four task towers, temporal/behavior residuals, union identity readouts and zero-initialized inherited heads
Auxiliary scorer/item/action gradient blocks; context gradients remain shared; frozen host data, history visibility, losses, seed, precision, optimizer and scoring
study.proposed_difference: Parameter-free bounded score/value covariance in the pooled value path only. Four standalone modules have identical learned modules and CONFIG except transport_mode. All compute pointwise cosine, within-slot reversal indices, and paired/reversed FP32 cross-moments; only exposed covariance/query alignment differs. No file/network access in model. No new labels, timestamps, user identifiers, history length or host changes. The inherited base mean can have BF16 reduction rounding whereas new covariance statistics are FP32; the exact weight/mass derivation does not assert bitwise convexity of the implemented mixed-precision result.
predictions: Primary predeclared contrast: aligned_values click validation AUC exceeds null_values and reversed_values at the frozen full protocol; practical screening threshold +0.0001 for each before spending follow-up repetition resources. This threshold is a research decision, not a significance test.
Secondary attribution: aligned_values exceeds rotated_values if same-coordinate target alignment matters. Rotation is information preserving, so parity does not refute all target conditioning.

Long-history and history17_64 slices may show larger aligned-minus-null AUC than history1_16 because older broad slots compress more events; this is exploratory, and history length does not perfectly identify slot heterogeneity. Empty and all-singleton fixtures have identical fixed-weight outputs in all modes.

All cells have exactly the inherited learned capacity (expected32295406 total,31793216 embedding,502190 dense), unchanged scorer populations and counts. Measured cost is expected above incumbent; no efficiency claim unless the measured quality-cost frontier justifies it.
falsifiers: Failure to beat both null and reversed controls rejects a useful aligned association gain for this implementation/recipe, not all target-conditioned compression.
If reversed or rotated match/beat aligned, semantic alignment attribution is unsupported; general reweighting, coordinate adaptation or optimization may explain any null-control gain.
A null implementation that fails fixed-weight FP32/BF16 output/gradient/Dice equivalence to incumbent invalidates the reference; do not train until a separately recorded fix.

Any label/input leakage, padding dependence, count/mass error, source-gradient breach, parameter/RNG mismatch, nonfinite output/gradient, memory failure or trial cap violation invalidates the affected execution. Preserve the failure receipt and do not change frozen host contracts.
alternative_explanations: Earlier target router g2-r0009-target10 underperformed its history-query control; no assumption of transfer to this later architecture is warranted.

One-pass optimization, dense clipping, BF16 quantization and changed embedding gradients can explain differences without better information retention. No new learnable parameters does not imply identical optimization capacity.

Reversal preserves score marginals but changes chronological and content association inside each age/feedback slot, including overlapping uniform versus feedback slots. It is deterministic, with identical singleton pairs; no independent shuffle/noise claim.
Rotated queries preserve target information and trainable embeddings can adapt. It controls a coordinate alignment bias only.
Transport changes the value readout in both click and auxiliary routes; the original detached auxiliary correction path is kept. Auxiliary task quality may trade off with click selection.

Existing residual/identity paths can compensate for null transport. Repeated validation selection and single-seed noise limit small improvements. The equal-versus-norm result supports the next question only provisionally.
